# Core Rule 4 - IC in OOC
- No using out of character means to speak about in character events for 30 minutes
- Don’t use OOC means to metagame factions (such as Clear Sky)
- Only faction specific reports in discord may be treated as character to character communication, use good sense on what counts, ask if you’re unsure.
- Do not use LOOC to insult, complain excessively, or communicate in character information.
